# py2mqtt

> There is a bit of an air of mystery around this project...


## Pages in this subsection

- [py2mqtt](index.html.md): Interfaces for Python to transmit, receive, and act on data over an MQTT connection.
- [py2mqtt.client](client/index.html.md): Defines functions to instantiate and access an MQTT client.
- [py2mqtt.mqtt_function_caller](mqtt_function_caller/index.html.md): Placeholder for calling functions over MQTT (not yet implemented).
- [py2mqtt.mqtt_reader](mqtt_reader/index.html.md): Defines the MQTTTopicReader class
- [py2mqtt.util](util/index.html.md): Main documentation page
